name: DLF Privana West
summary: Existence, DLF as developer, the Sector 76 / SPR location, the 12.57-acre land area, 5 towers, the 3,577 sq ft 4 BHK size and a ~₹7.2–7.8 Cr entry price are confirmed. Our unit count (164) is wrong: DLF and HARERA-derived sources give ~795 units. We also publish the HARERA project ID RERA-GRG-1540-2024 instead of the registration certificate number RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/819/551/2024/46. Possession is not published (DLF marketing says December 2028; the RERA completion date is reported as 31 Dec 2031).
